description: Na₂SiF₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P321 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SiF₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-64°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.28 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiF₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-64°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.37 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to six F atoms to form SiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 43°. All Si-F bond lengths are 1.70 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form SiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 47°. All Si-F bond lengths are 1.70 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Si atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Si atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Si atom.
